rendered: The anode-free full cell uses a pyrite (FeS2) cathode. The document states that[1] we employed pyrite (FeS2) for the cathode[2]. Because pyrite natively contains no sodium, it is presodiated before cell assembly, as the document says: presodiated the pyrite cathode prior to cell assembly[3]. The cell is therefore built from presodiated pyrite paired with carbon/Al current collectors in a discharged state, and sodium is plated in situ on the carbon/Al collector during the initial charge, so the cell does not contain sodium metal on assembly[4]. The energy density was calculated on the mass of the presodiated pyrite, assuming assuming a Na1.5FeS2 stoichiometry[5], and the FeS2 cathode capacity assumed was 335 mAh/g[6] for the energy density.
